summary: break stops a loop early and continue skips to the next pass. Use them when you are searching for something or need to skip bad data.
notes: for (const score of scores) gives each item in order. const works because each pass gets a new score.
continue jumps to the next pass, so the "Passing" line is skipped for -1. break leaves the loop, so 75 is never checked.
Set a flag like foundFailing before break and check it after the loop.
pitfall: Using break inside forEach(), as in scores.forEach((s) => { if (s < 60) break; }), causes SyntaxError: Illegal break statement. Use a for...of loop when you need break.
contrast: JavaScript uses break and continue the same way as Python and Java. Like Java, it has no for...else, so you use a boolean flag.
